latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Add specification for WASI v0.3.1 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/WebAssembly/WASI/pull/952
* Remove myself from WASI HTTP champions. by @PiotrSikora in https://github.com/WebAssembly/WASI/pull/956
* Remove David Justice as a WASI proposal champion by @devigned in https://github.com/WebAssembly/WASI/pull/957
* Update WASI HTTP champions by @lukewagner in https://github.com/WebAssembly/WASI/pull/960
* chore(deps): bump the github-actions group across 1 directory with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/WebAssembly/WASI/pull/955
* docs(triage): add close template messages by @ricochet in https://github.com/WebAssembly/WASI/pull/959
* Release WASI v0.3.2 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/WebAssembly/WASI/pull/963

## New Contributors
* @devigned made their first contribution in https://github.com/WebAssembly/WASI/pull/957
* @lukewagner made their first contribution in https://github.com/WebAssembly/WASI/pull/960

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/WebAssembly/WASI/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2
